messages:
pagerduty-bot: [P1] High GPU queue growth detected in eu-west-1 — 11/15 pools saturated, aggregate queue ~650k requests, token backlog rising. Link: https://console.redwood/alerts/4151236789 :rotating_light:

pagerduty-bot: Symptoms: autoscaler retrying, provider 429s, queue growth >5%/min for 12m. Paging oncall.

sara: I'm on it, taking pager. Anyone else available for quick triage? :eyes:

jim: here. seeing autoscaler errors repeatedly getting 429/RateLimitExceeded from provider when provisioning new instances. Also one node in dedicated-eu-01 shows driver OOM-kill and crash-looping GPU driver.

maya: adding — our runtime shows a huge spike in KV cache miss rate (~7x baseline) starting ~10m before alert. That increases per-request GPU work (more context uncached). Might be cache invalidation from last deploy.

alex: trying manual scale on dedicated-eu-01 to +4 GPUs, cloud API returns 429. Provider status page shows scheduled maintenance and quota enforcement in eu-west-1.

sara: mitigation plan: 1) divert non-critical traffic to eu-central fallback; 2) suspend batch/rerank jobs; 3) open provider support case; 4) reduce max_tokens temporarily. Who can flip routing quickly?

liam: I can flip routing — doing canary redirect to eu-central now. Command I used:

```bash
redwood route update --from eu-west-1 --to eu-central --tags "non-critical"
```

liam: done. traffic shifted ~28% away from eu-west-1. queue growth slowed a bit. :white_check_mark:

jim: paused internal batch reranks via admin API:

```http
POST /admin/rerank/pause
{"reason": "incident-4151236789"}
```

maya: attempted cache warmup but warmup job timed out (OOM on prefetch). I'm going to increase cache retention window and enable aggressive prefetch for top prefixes to reduce miss storm. Applying patch now.

sara: applied temporary token cap on API keys identified as heavy hitters (cap = 512 tokens) to reduce tokens/sec. Done via console.

deploy-bot: deploy 4151236789-kgcp-prefetch started on eng-runtime/kv-prefetch v2.1.3

maya: patch is live. KV cache miss rate down ~60% within 6m, latency improving.

pagerduty-bot: update — queue length plateaued at ~150k and is trending down. No spike in 5xx after reroute.

cs-bot: CS update: notified impacted customers (cust-A, cust-B) with interim mitigation ETA ~30-45m. No revenue-impacting customers reported as of now.

alex: provider replied — temporary quota throttle due to maintenance; they offered a reservation window for resupply if we accept. Opening ticket for priority capacity.

sara: can we safe-scale more GPUs in a different AZ/region to regain headroom while provider responds?

alex: there are cross-az constraints; eu-central has spare capacity. I propose provisioning +8 GPUs in eu-central and shifting overflow there. Will request and coordinate.

jim: agreed. I'll coordinate autoscaler policy changes to prefer eu-central on overflow and ensure no runaway scale actions.

liam: autoscaler policy updated to prefer eu-central on overflow. Snippet used:

```yaml
overflow_policy:
  prefer_regions: [eu-central]
  max_scale_per_min: 20
```

sara: live-mitigation summary: rerouted ~28% traffic, paused batch jobs, deployed kv-prefetch patch, applied token caps, requested provider emergency capacity, updated autoscaler overflow policy. Monitoring closely.

maya: monitoring metrics: P95 latency dropped from ~4200ms -> ~1400ms since mitigations; queue deltas are negative.

sara: I'm switching pager to 'monitoring' but keep thread open for postmortem and action items. Good job triaging. :tada:

jim: action items (owners/due):
- jim: draft postmortem (48h)
- alex: follow up with provider procurement/reservation + confirm timelines (24h)
- maya: harden KV-prefetch, add unit/integration tests, and add safety limits (72h)
- liam: add automated reroute play to runbook + e2e test (72h)
- sara: customer comms follow-up and SLA impact assessment (24h)

liam: quick ops note — we should add a metric alert for 'KV cache miss spike' as a leading indicator. I'll add it to alerts and dashboards.

jim: leaving incident summary for timeline (short):

"Root cause: provider quota enforcement in eu-west-1 during provider maintenance combined with a runtime KV cache invalidation after deploy. The cache invalidation increased per-request GPU work and token cost, exhausting GPU capacity. Autoscaler attempts were rate-limited by provider 429s and could not procure additional GPUs.

Mitigations performed: traffic reroute to eu-central, paused low-priority batch jobs, deployed KV-prefetch patch to reduce cache misses, applied temporary token caps for heavy API keys, requested provider emergency capacity, and adjusted autoscaler overflow policy."

sara: recorded incident board entry: https://boards.redwood/incidents/4151236789

pagerduty-bot: Incident acknowledged by oncall sara. Status set to mitigated -> monitoring. Close reason: manual-close by sara at 4151237105

sara: closing the active pager. I'll create the full postmortem doc and link it here when ready. Thanks team.
